official_metadata.setting: Neon-lit South Korean commercial shopping district and subway entrance
official_metadata.official_description: An urban commercial district in South Korea featuring narrow street alleys, ground-level convenience stores, a gaming den interior, and a central sunken subway entrance designed for rapid boots-on-the-ground skirmishes.
official_metadata.provenance: Activision / Infinity Ward Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Official Intel

cut_the_cake_suitability.analysis_notes: Cut the Cake Inference: Strong 2D planar applicability. Most engagements occur on the street and interior floor planes, with straightforward solid partitions.
